name: research-data
description: Discover scoped research datasets, exact series and regulator identifiers; inspect source-bound changes and retrieve bounded cited observations. Preserve native units, capture receipts, snapshot identifiers, independent source clocks, rights and coverage gaps so an analyst can reproduce a captured review. Historical vintages do not establish earlier point-in-time availability; stale or unverified current analysis may be withheld.

interface.shortDescription: Cited funding and institution source data
interface.longDescription: Discover scoped research datasets, exact series and regulator identifiers; inspect source-bound changes and retrieve bounded cited observations. Preserve native units, capture receipts, snapshot identifiers, independent source clocks, rights and coverage gaps so an analyst can reproduce a captured review. Historical vintages do not establish earlier point-in-time availability; stale or unverified current analysis may be withheld.
defaultPrompt: Review Seiche's research workspace coverage, source freshness and missing evidence.
Discover a permitted funding dataset and retrieve twenty cited observations using its exact series ID.
Find existing Indian institution dossiers matching 'AU' and explain coverage gaps.

positive.prompt: Read the Seiche research workspace and summarize coverage, source freshness, gaps and snapshot identifier.
positive.expected_behavior: Use product seiche; retain independent source clocks, snapshot identity and unavailable evidence without treating response time as observation time.

positive.prompt: Discover datasets available for LiquiLens research and explain each dataset's coverage and rights.
positive.expected_behavior: Use product liquilens, preserve exact dataset IDs and rights, and avoid presenting registry presence as complete financial coverage.

positive.prompt: Discover a permitted Seiche dataset and metric, then retrieve at most twenty observations using their exact returned IDs. Preserve units, dates, citations and missing values.
positive.expected_behavior: Use product seiche for discovery, copy exact dataset and series IDs, and set observation limit 20. Stop if no permitted series is available; do not infer historical availability.

positive.prompt: Search existing Indian dossiers for 'AU', return at most ten results and explain financial-evidence gaps and population overlap.
positive.expected_behavior: Use scope dossiers, q AU and limit 10. Retain source clocks and gaps; do not treat overlapping populations as a global institution census.

positive.prompt: Read Undertow's descriptive research analysis and explain returned settlement findings, input references and limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Use product undertow, cite returned inputs and scope, and preserve withheld or unavailable analysis without causal or execution claims.

negative.prompt: Place a market order to buy $5,000 of Bitcoin in my account.
Retrieve my confidential bank account balances without published records.
Write a four-line birthday poem for my friend.

publication.release_notes: Adds task-specific starter prompts and five positive plus three negative review cases; preserves the public research scope and MCP endpoint.
